survivors.claim: The plugin-bump gate is red at HEAD: spec/ changed since 2cea1e9 but the version is still 7.171.0 (base 7.171.0). The bump landed earlier in the branch; 76bef63 then edited spec/scripts/lib/client-capture.js with no further bump.
survivors.impact: A second behaviour change on a branch that already bumped once ships unversioned — the residue § Review Checks assigns to the reviewer, and hard there.
survivors.evidence: tests/consistency/plugin-bump.test.js:49 fails on this checkout with '❌ spec: spec/ changed since 2cea1e9 but version is 7.171.0 (base 7.171.0)'. Provenance cannot dismiss it: the blamed commit 76bef63 is inside the range, so git merge-base --is-ancestor 76bef63 851ede5 cannot hold.

survivors.claim: 76bef63 deleted `if (value && value.error) throw new Error(value.error)` and replaced it with `resolve(value && value.error ? { mode: null, region: null } : value)`. The only value.error the eval can produce is 'NotesAnchor is not loaded on <href>' — i.e. the served page came back without the notes layer.
survivors.impact: A wiring failure is now reported to the owner as 'box lost — the owner will be asked to re-place it', indistinguishable from a genuinely removed anchor. A defensive fallback masking a wiring bug. The commit subject ('the served page carries no anchor') also describes a different condition than the line it changes.
survivors.evidence: Read of spec/scripts/lib/client-capture.js:282 against the eval expression above it, which emits value.error only for the missing-NotesAnchor case.
